item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01915","case1_error":"Computes fuel cost from miles times price per gallon, omitting conversion to gallons using fuel efficiency.","case2_error":"Omits the cow's $600 purchase price from total costs when calculating profit.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect unit conversion relation; the second leaves out an entire expense.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01916","case1_error":"Sets Roger's current experience equal to his retirement target, ignoring Tom's stated experience relation.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written expression 12 + 6 - 1 + 5 - 2 as 18 instead of 20.","reason":"The first imposes an erroneous relation; the second makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01917","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 20, but the correct derivation and concluding answer give 16.","case2_error":"Subtracts only one week's 12 required chores from the two-week total instead of subtracting 24.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01918","case1_error":"Inserts an unsupported $3,000 tax expense without calculating the stated 20% tax.","case2_error":"Subtracts the cost of one necklace from revenue for 30 necklaces, failing to scale production costs.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported tax amount; the second incorrectly treats a per-necklace cost as the total production cost.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01919","case1_error":"Evaluates 110 + 310 + 215 + 560 + 780 as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Evaluates 34 - 8 - 9 as 27 instead of 17.","reason":"Both incorrectly evaluate explicitly written, correct arithmetic expressions.","judgment":"same"}]}
